subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should reconfiguring an already-existing keyed session’s model or thinking level be an admin-only Gateway operation, even for existing write-scoped integrations?
rationale: The implementation intentionally removes a previously available write-scoped mutation path; the correct compatibility and security policy cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Confirm admin-only reconfiguration
options.body: Keep the state-aware gate and require real runtime proof that the new write denial and admin path behave as intended.

options.title: Preserve write-scoped reconfiguration
options.body: Reject the new gate if reused keyed sessions are intentionally editable by ordinary write-scoped Gateway clients.

recommendation.title: Confirm admin-only reconfiguration
recommendation.body: Keep the state-aware gate and require real runtime proof that the new write denial and admin path behave as intended.
